text.en: Clients frequently praise Dr Mariya, Danielle, and the physiotherapy team for their kindness, medical expertise, and empathetic approach. Pet owners feel reassured by the welcoming atmosphere and thoughtful consultations. While one reviewer experienced fragmented specialist communication, the clinical team is widely admired.

Reviewers appreciate the patient handling shown towards nervous rescue dogs, senior pets, and unwell cats during visits. Physiotherapists allow pets to adapt at their own pace, transforming initially hesitant animals into enthusiastic visitors. Owners value the gentle bedside manner exhibited across examinations.

Dog owners report remarkable mobility improvements for pets recovering from spinal surgeries, arthritis, and limb injuries. Clients highlight effective rehabilitation utilizing hydrotherapy treadmills, therapeutic laser, and gait analysis technology. The tailored therapy programmes significantly enhance quality of life.

q.en: Does the clinic offer hydrotherapy and physiotherapy?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight dedicated canine hydrotherapy, laser therapy, and structured physical rehabilitation.

q.en: What advanced diagnostic tools are utilized in therapy?

a.en: The clinic incorporates digital gait analysis sensors and rehabilitation treadmills to monitor canine recovery.

q.en: Are pricing structures clearly explained to clients?

a.en: Yes, customers note that fees are explained transparently in advance, though therapy services reflect London rates.

q.en: Can home visits and emergency care be arranged?

a.en: Yes, the clinic coordinates neighbourhood home visits alongside out-of-hours coverage via partner hospitals.
